about: MWManager's own notes for option choices, shown in the option window after the FOMOD text, the packaged readmes and the mod page. A mod matches by its Nexus id or by a package-folder pattern; each option pattern is matched (case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards, / or \) against the option's label, key, file name and path inside the package. '*' notes the whole package. An option's value is a note, or an object with a note, optional needs (which hold chosen options), and optional requires objects with name and nexus_id (informational only).

options.*AATL_Data.esp: Modder's resource: this plugin is for mod authors working in the Construction Set. Players do not need it; leave it unchecked.

options.*Firemoth Remover*: Only enable this plugin if you would prefer the official add-on version of Siege at Firemoth. Tamriel Rebuilt includes an extensive overhaul of that add-on, and this plugin removes it.

options.*2D Moss*: Significantly smaller files for users with lower-end systems. It overwrites the larger 3D moss meshes in the main mod. If your system is modern and capable, leave this unchecked.

options.*Windoors*: Windoors is a very hard to find mod from a Russian author. If you do not have a copy, or a reasonable idea how to get it, don't install this patch.

Dark Molag Mar*.note: MWMANAGER INSIGHT: This patch is for the separate mod Dark Molag Mar, a readily available plugin from Nexus; it is not part of Glow in the Dahrk. Nexus ID 32101. Its meshes (Meshes\rtfmm\) only do something with Dark Molag Mar installed. If selected, MWManager queues Dark Molag Mar and uses its archive when available; otherwise it opens the Nexus mod page for download. If not selected, that choice is remembered and offered again when Dark Molag Mar is installed later.

Animated Containers.note: This needs the full MW Containers Animated mod. Some Improved Animated Containers is only an optional mesh overwrite and does not substitute for it.
